hook: ChatGPT free mein ab unlimited chat, par ek catch hai.

beats.narration: ChatGPT free mein ab unlimited chat, par ek catch hai.
August 2026 se OpenAI ne free users ke liye text chats unlimited kar diye.
beats.claim: On August 6, 2026 OpenAI announced unlimited text chats for free and Go users, starting the week of August 10.

beats.narration: Free plan pe aapko GPT-5.6 Luna milta hai, is family ka sabse chhota model.
beats.claim: Free accounts are limited to GPT-5.6 Luna, the smallest model in the GPT-5.6 family.

beats.narration: Mushkil sawaal ho, to Think button dabao. Ye zyada soch ke jawab deta hai.
beats.claim: Free accounts get a Think button with a single reasoning mode.

beats.narration: Catch ye hai: images, file upload, voice aur Deep Research pe weekly limit lagti hai. Settings mein Usage check kar lo.
beats.claim: Free accounts have limits on file and image uploads, image generation, Deep Research and voice, under one weekly limit visible in Settings > Usage.

beats.narration: Aur free plan pe jawab ke neeche sponsored ads bhi dikh sakte hain.
beats.claim: Free users may see ads in a sponsored section below responses.

beats.narration: Roz ke text kaam ke liye free kaafi hai. Images aur files roz chahiye, tabhi paid plan ka socho.

title: ChatGPT free mein unlimited chat, par ek catch hai
description: Free ChatGPT 2026: unlimited text, GPT-5.6 Luna, Think button. Limits images, files aur voice pe hain. Source: Engadget, Aug 2026.
